result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVParserAgentTest.java` with 24 self-contained JUnit 4 tests covering `CSVParser`: constructor/factory null-argument validation, happy-path parsing, empty input, header map handling (explicit, auto-detected, absent, duplicate names), null-string conversion, line/record number tracking, iterator semantics (`hasNext`/`next`/`remove`/post-close behavior), comment attachment, invalid-token `IOException`, EOF handling, file-based parsing, and idempotent `close()`. All tests compile under `-source 8` and pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
